mapper.select: SELECT group_code, name, description, sort_order FROM tb_code_group ORDER BY sort_order, group_code
SELECT group_code, code, label, parent_code, sort_order, active, attrs, updated_at FROM tb_code ORDER BY group_code, sort_order, code_id
SELECT coalesce(to_char(max(updated_at) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'), 'empty') || '#' || count(*) FROM tb_code

SELECT 'CATEGORY' AS group_code, category AS code, count(*) AS count FROM tb_wardrobe_item GROUP BY category UNION ALL SELECT 'SUB_TYPE', sub_type, count(*) FROM tb_wardrobe_item GROUP BY sub_type UNION ALL SELECT 'COLOR', color, count(*) FROM tb_wardrobe_item GROUP BY color UNION ALL SELECT 'PATTERN', pattern, count(*) FROM tb_wardrobe_item GROUP BY pattern UNION ALL SELECT 'ITEM_STATUS', status, count(*) FROM tb_wardrobe_item GROUP BY status UNION ALL SELECT 'SEASON', s.v, count(*) FROM tb_wardrobe_item i CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(i.seasons) AS s(v) GROUP BY s.v UNION ALL SELECT 'STYLE', s.v, count(*) FROM tb_wardrobe_item i CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(i.styles) AS s(v) GROUP BY s.v

SELECT count(*) FROM tb_user_profile
WHERE #{code} = ANY (colors) WHERE #{code} = ANY (moods) WHERE FALSE
